$comment: Workstream R Batch-0 reality audit (new15 Execution Plan section 6.2). Symbol bindings for the 21 named subsystems, read from files at 84f56c5 — never from planning prose. SCHEMA NOTE: section 6.2's example gives ONE scalar path and ONE scalar symbol per row. Sixteen rows honour that shape exactly. Five rows (4, 11, 14, 20, 21) have TWO OR MORE REAL OWNERS and carry bindings[{path,symbol,role,note}] instead, because the example shape cannot express them: naming one owner loses the fact that a second exists, and inventing a composite path is fiction. Both errors point a later batch at the wrong file. The schema was extended rather than the truth flattened.
